title: Early Morning Sunwatch
text:
🌅 Early Morning Sunwatch — November 18, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Moderate (C1.1)
🔥 Latest solar flare: C3.6 (Peaked November 18, 2026 at 10:15 UTC)
🔥 Strongest recent flare: M1.7 (Peaked November 17, 2026 at 21:39 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 392 km/s (Moderate)
🧲 Bz: −5.2 nT (Southward)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 2.33)
🚨 NOAA Warning: Geomagnetic K-index of 4 expected

Sunny reporting for duty! ✨

Several bright active regions are visible across the Sun today, alongside a distinct sunspot group and several smaller groups.

Image: NOAA GOES-19 SUVI — 171 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
